metadata.title: That 2 kill spree where Valorant said ‘Yep, take this and confuse everyone’ LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just get lucky twice?
Enemy probably uninstalling after this.
Click if your aim’s a mystery but the game’s handing out freebies!
Valorant logic at its finest.

Tap if your best kills come from pure chaos!
